name: xl_generator
description: Generate Excel (.xlsx) files from record templates: fill the source name, ip and region on every record, for one source or many.

arguments.name: action
arguments.description: generate an Excel file, create (or replace) a template, list the templates, or delete a saved template.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: single: one source (source_name, source_ip, source_region) on all records. multiple: every source in 'sources' / 'sources_file' gets its own copy of the records.

arguments.name: template
arguments.description: Template to start from: one shipped in the plugin's templates/ folder or one saved with action create_template. Run action list_templates to see them.

arguments.name: template_file
arguments.description: A .csv or .xlsx file on the server used as the template instead of 'template' (first row: column names; next rows: records).

arguments.name: source_name
arguments.description: Mode single: source name written on every record.

arguments.name: source_ip
arguments.description: Mode single: source ip (or network) written on every record.

arguments.name: source_region
arguments.description: Mode single: source region, optional; left as in the template when empty.

arguments.name: sources
arguments.description: Mode multiple: one source per line (or separated by ';') as 'name, ip[, region]', or a list of objects {"name", "ip", "region"}.

arguments.name: sources_file
arguments.description: Mode multiple: .csv or .xlsx file of sources, with a header row (name, ip, region) or plain columns in that order.

arguments.name: layout
arguments.description: Mode multiple: all records on one sheet (rows) or one sheet per source (sheets).

arguments.name: records
arguments.description: Only these template records (1-based numbers and ranges, like '1,3,5-7'); all when empty.

arguments.name: values
arguments.description: Other columns to set on every record, by column name.

arguments.name: output_name
arguments.description: File name of the Excel file (.xlsx is added). Default: <template>-<source>-<date-time>.xlsx.

arguments.name: output_dir
arguments.description: Folder the Excel file is written to. Default: the plugin's data folder (<workspace>/plugin-data/custom.xl_generator/project-<id>/files). The file is also listed in Tools -> Artifacts.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Replace an existing Excel file (generate) or saved template (create_template) of the same name.

arguments.name: template_name
arguments.description: create_template / delete_template: name of the saved template (letters, digits, '_', '-', '.').

arguments.name: columns
arguments.description: create_template: column names of the new template. When empty, the new template copies 'template' / 'template_file'.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.description: create_template: the static records, as CSV text (one record per line) or a list of lists or objects by column name. When empty, the records of the copied template are kept.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: generate: the Excel file written. create_template: the saved template file.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: Records written (generate) or kept in the template (create_template).

outputs.name: sheets
outputs.description: generate: sheets in the Excel file.

outputs.name: templates
outputs.description: list_templates: name, origin (plugin or saved), columns and record count of each template.
